summary: 22 original claims/clusters stronger-original (mostly uncontested: RightNow no-vendor-mechanism, Step 2 networks, TGC/CT raw figures, PC developer program and directory on-ramp, PC relative scale, Pushpay/CCB/ChurchTrac, Step 5 podcast figures, all three Facebook direct reads, App Store featuring); 4 stronger-counter (RightNow 30K+ -> ~20K paying via Form 990 arithmetic; RightNow 4.5M -> cumulative via install proxies; PC install base -> 78,000+ vendor-stated; Lifeway corroboration -> none for current roster); 2 original claims disproven ('73K vs 100K+ as a two-source contest' is one vendor origin plus a bad secondary; 5 Leadership Questions ~2M downloads corroborates nothing about the current network); 5 overstated but not contradicted (original: PC install base conflated with reach, TGC '6-7x inflation' is a unit mismatch, Pushpay corroboration_count 2 is effectively 1; counter: 'roughly consistent with 30K+' understates its own arithmetic, Vanco release over-credited as small-app evidence); 1 original claim false ('no current first-party figure' for Planning Center — three product pages state 78,000+); 10 unresolved (RightNow 20K/30K gap meaning and uncited pricing input; whether PC integrations directory drives any discovery for a consumer small-group app; whether 78K is engaged churches or an account ceiling; what Lifeway '200K+ reached monthly' counts; whether Group Answers / 5 Leadership Questions are still active; TGC 40M unit; DLN scale/terms; SGN FB group vs faith.tools in practice; Google Play / missed channels; pricing of budget channels). Both headline designations survive with requotes: Planning Center as best actionable-now on-ramp (not demonstrated reach), RightNow as best requires-leverage at ~20K paying / 30K claimed.
